packageRules.description: Every minor and patch update in one pull request, to keep the pull request noise down; majors stay apart

ROCm moves as one and on its own: both rocm/dev-ubuntu base images (llama-cpp, stable-diffusion-cpp) in one pull request, every update type, outside the non-major group. The host installer (cli/commands/setup/amdgpu.sh) pins the same release and Renovate does not track it, so this is never automerged
prBodyNotes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Move the host to the same ROCm release before merging: follow `.agents/skills/rocm-upgrade/` (`rocm_release` in `cli/commands/setup/amdgpu.sh`, the docs and the rebuilt `bin/panther-minor`) in this pull request.
